patch.value: Provide an audited repair and severity-migration contract for legacy invalid provenance

GH-998 documents 1,255 immutable events written by older pm-cli versions with CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION captured as role=1. The capture bug and advisory disposition are closed, but no supported repair exists and severity changed across releases. Add a privacy-safe dry-run plan and audited rewrite/disposition path, plus an explicit compatibility policy for validation severity changes.

A supported command inventories and dry-runs invalid legacy provenance repairs without exposing raw sensitive values; an authorized apply path preserves hash-chain and workspace replay integrity with an immutable audit receipt; health remediation names the exact command; validation severity cannot become blocking before compatible repair exists and is announced; GH-998 is linked in evidence
